people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: In his days Judah will be saved, and Israel will dwell safely. This is his name by which he will be called: Yahweh our righteousness.
translations.bsb: In His days Judah will be saved, and Israel will dwell securely. And this is His name by which He will be called: The LORD Our Righteousness.
